documents.title: Discharge Summary - Hyperglycemia
documents.text: 65-year-old male with type 2 diabetes admitted with blood glucose of 412 mg/dL and mild dehydration. Treated with IV fluids and an insulin infusion, then moved to basal-bolus insulin. HbA1c 7.2%. Discharged in stable condition on metformin 1000 mg twice daily and insulin glargine 20 units nightly. Follow up with primary care in 2 weeks for a glucose log review.

documents.title: Chest X-ray, 2 views
documents.text: Indication: persistent cough for 3 weeks. Findings: lungs are clear with no focal consolidation, effusion or pneumothorax. Heart size is normal. Impression: no acute cardiopulmonary process.

documents.title: Discharge Summary - CHF exacerbation
documents.text: 78-year-old male with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (EF 30%) admitted with shortness of breath and leg swelling. BNP 850 pg/mL. Diuresed with IV furosemide, 4 kg net weight loss. Creatinine rose to 2.1 mg/dL, likely from diuresis. Discharged on furosemide 40 mg daily with a daily weight log and a low-sodium diet.

documents.title: Thyroid ultrasound
documents.text: Indication: palpable neck nodule. Findings: 1.2 cm solid hypoechoic nodule in the right thyroid lobe with smooth margins. No suspicious lymph nodes. Impression: TI-RADS 4, fine needle aspiration recommended.

documents.title: ED progress note - hyperkalemia
documents.text: 40-year-old male with chronic kidney disease stage 4 seen for weakness. Potassium 6.8 mmol/L (critical). ECG shows peaked T waves. Given calcium gluconate, insulin with dextrose and a potassium binder. Repeat potassium 5.4 after 4 hours. Nephrology consulted.

documents.title: Discharge Summary - Community acquired pneumonia
documents.text: Admitted with fever, productive cough and right lower lobe consolidation on chest X-ray. Treated with ceftriaxone and azithromycin, then switched to oral amoxicillin-clavulanate. Afebrile for 48 hours before discharge. Complete a 7-day antibiotic course. LDL noted at 145 mg/dL, start statin at follow up.

documents.title: Annual labs - interpretation
documents.text: Comprehensive metabolic panel within normal limits. HbA1c 5.4% (normal). Lipid panel: total cholesterol 188 mg/dL, LDL 110 mg/dL. No changes to the current plan. Repeat in 12 months.

documents.title: MRI brain without contrast
documents.text: Indication: memory loss over 1 year. Findings: moderate generalized volume loss, more than expected for age, with hippocampal atrophy. Scattered white matter changes consistent with small vessel disease. No mass or acute infarct. Impression: findings may support a neurodegenerative process; clinical correlation advised.

documents.title: Discharge Summary - Chest pain, ACS ruled out
documents.text: 46-year-old male admitted for chest pain. Serial troponin I below 0.04 ng/mL. ECG without ischemic changes. Stress test negative for inducible ischemia. Pain likely musculoskeletal. Discharged with NSAIDs as needed and cardiology follow up.

documents.title: Transthoracic echocardiogram
documents.text: Normal left ventricle size and function, EF 60%. No valve disease. No pericardial effusion. Normal study.

documents.title: Discharge Summary - Cellulitis
documents.text: Left lower leg cellulitis treated with IV cefazolin, then oral cephalexin. Redness reduced. Discharged to finish a 10-day course.

documents.title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
documents.text: Indication: right lower quadrant pain. Findings: normal appendix. Several small diverticula in the sigmoid colon without inflammation. Simple cyst in the left kidney, 1.5 cm. Impression: no acute abnormality; diverticulosis.
